title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-clockwork: carry parked/agent/CLOCKWORK onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/CLOCKWORK` at 965a566192 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: doctrine/growth.json, foundation/__main__.py, foundation/clockwork.py, instances/ultrastable/loop-registry.json)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/parked/agent/CLOCKWORK is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --scan --json shows no `port` for parked/agent/CLOCKWORK
